notes: ἕως ἄν is compressed into the single word till, so rule 50 makes the pair one aligned unit headed on that word rather than leaving the particle empty; leaving ἄν unrepresented would be the correction rule 50 names.
οὐ μή takes the whole English negation as one noncompositional unit under rule 33, and παρέλθῃ keeps its auxiliary and preverb particle discontinuously around it under rule 15.
